WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
         s.insurstat,
         AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_record_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
), kept_sites AS (
  SELECT sr.*, sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios AS sr
  JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat
  WHERE sr.avg_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT insurstat,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_site_ratio,
       SUM(mesh_record_count) AS total_mesh_records,
       AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_over_status_average
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat;

assumptions.assumption: A site's mesh-record count includes every matched scanmesh row, even when that row has a NULL resolution or geometric accuracy; only missing or zero-denominator ratios are excluded from the site's ratio average. Sites with no mesh records do not enter the site averages.
